title: Force Complete Brief on /ops/wo chooses its CMS and template like a customer's revision instead of a hard-coded Joomla ja_restora
steps: S1: with Tracy Base released on the three CMS, no CMS chosen by the account and the /ops/wo defaults, press force-complete-brief on a legacy opportunity.
S2: the account chose WordPress in Settings; press force-complete-brief.
S3: /ops/wo pins tracy-base/emdash-9.x (not released) under the strict policy; press force-complete-brief.
S4: the same missing pin under the default fallback policy; press force-complete-brief.
expect: S1: the revision has cms emdash, cms_source ops_force, template quickstart tracy-base/emdash-0.x, design tracy, reason pinned.
S2: cms wordpress, template quickstart tracy-base/wp7, reason pinned.
S3: the action answers 409 TEMPLATE_PIN_UNAVAILABLE, writes no revision and leaves the sources as they were (whole action rolled back).
S4: cms emdash, the fallback fit (tracy-base/emdash-0.x here), reason starting pin-missing:tracy-base/emdash-9.x;.
evidence: Before: insertForcedRevision wrote cms 'joomla' and template {slug: 'ja_restora', cms: 'joomla'} whatever the account or /ops/wo said (#1461 decision, 19/10/2026).
fence: The forced brief uses the same chooseTemplate/resolveRevisionCms as createRevision (lib/wo-revision-choice.js) and the same preference lock key as Settings saves.

tests: force-complete-brief with no CMS chosen builds the /ops/wo default CMS from its pin
force-complete-brief follows the account's own CMS and that CMS's pin
force-complete-brief under a strict pin no longer offered is refused like a revision, writing nothing
force-complete-brief with a pin no longer offered falls back and says why
a forced brief and a Settings save lock the same preference key
